title: yardstick-predict forecast request, version 1
description: A field that may be left out may also be null, which means the same as leaving it out.

predictor.description: Which predictor to use. Default: your default predictor, set with `yardstick-predict default NAME`.

distribution.description: Also return each forecast's full curve.

id.description: Your id for the task. Unique in the request.

prompt.description: The prompt the agent will get. It needs some text, not only spaces. Like a prompt in training, it's used without the spaces at its ends and only its first 24,000 characters count.

models.description: The AI models to forecast the task on. A model named twice is forecast once.

context.description: The conversation so far, if there is one. Only its last 24,000 characters count.

effort.description: The thinking level. Default: the model's most common one.

agent.description: claude-code or codex. Default: the model's most common one.

skills.description: Skills known before the task runs, by name: the ones the conversation used before it. The ones the prompt invokes, such as a typed /command, are read from the prompt, so they may be left out. A predictor with the skills feature embeds their descriptions.

extra.description: Values for features you added yourself. Each one reaches your feature as info.extra.

project.description: The project's folder name. The forecast uses the project's recent tasks from your records, and features you add can use it.

session.description: The conversation the task is in, by its id in the agent's records. The forecast uses what its earlier tasks took.

conversation_tokens.description: How big the conversation is so far, in tokens. 0, null or left out for a new one.
